label: The esse instance of holding from the timed strong concurrent actualization
description: New non-transcription conditional derivation connecting the holding vocabulary to the concurrent-actualization premise on main. Let x be in act as to being and able to lack being. Under the present-moment reading x is present at t and has received esse in some principle p; by the strong concurrent actualization 76d2cc96 some g other than x gives x being at t; under the reading g presently actualizes x as to being. Composed with the two derivations above, C* in the holding sense rests on 76d2cc96 (the strong version: the holder must be another), the present-moment reading, accident-inclusive conservation, the lackable-being bridge and the actualizer premise, all OPEN. So the strong concurrent actualization is a shared dependency of this First Way sibling and of the esse-root routes, which use its weak version (40a97664). No premise is established.
